name: TC-41: Verify successful card payment form filling with valid input data
description: Verify that all card payment fields accept and correctly display valid data.
descriptionHtml: Verify that all card payment fields accept and correctly display valid data.

testStage.description: Verify that all card payment fields accept and correctly display valid data.

steps.name: Enter a valid amount into the amount field
Get entered payment amount in WayForPay
Get currently selected currency in WayForPay
Fill complete payment form in WayForPay
Verify the state of the 'Оплатити' submit button after all fields are filled
Check if submit button is displayed
Check if submit button is enabled
Verify amount and currency remain correct after filling card details
Get entered payment amount in WayForPay
Get currently selected currency in WayForPay
